events.title: Business Innovation and Investment Program commences (1 July 2012)
events.description: Home Affairs FOI release dates the commencement of the BIIP (subclasses 188 and 888) to 1 July 2012. Day-precise account beside e-51d9cba7c3 (2019 discussion paper, July 2012). The amending regulations themselves are not stored.
events.location: p. 1, paragraph below the first bullet
events.quote: since the commencement of the programme on 1 July 2012 to 31 May 2016

events.title: Civil Registry Law 2002 allows exceptional naturalisation for services of the highest level
events.description: Para. 2(στ) of the Third Schedule of the Civil Registry Law of 2002 (Law 141(I)/2002) lets the Council of Ministers naturalise a foreigner, regardless of residence, in very exceptional cases of services of the highest level to the Republic, for reasons of public interest, informing Parliament in advance. It does not mention investors; the 2007-2013 investor criteria were adopted under it.

events.title: UK opens a migration route for investors (GBP 1 million)
events.description: The Migration Advisory Committee says the UK has operated an investor route since 1 October 1994: GBP 1 million held in the UK, GBP 750,000 invested in UK Government bonds, stocks or corporate bonds, and the UK as main home. The 1994 rules text is not stored.
events.quote: The UK Government has operated a migration route for investors since 1 October 1994.

events.title: 'Investor' category deleted and replaced by Tier 1 (Investor)
events.description: HC 607 deletes paragraphs 224 to 229 of the Immigration Rules (the 'investor' category), save as relevant to para 230, and creates Tier 1 (Investor) from 30 June 2008.
events.quote: These changes will come into force on 30th June 2008.

events.description: Immigration instructions BN3, effective 19 September 2022, set the Active Investor Plus resident visa: NZ$15 million or weighted equivalent, never less than NZ$5 million.

events.title: Investor Residency Programme opens for electronic applications
events.description: The ministry's Investment Services Centre begins receiving applications for investor residence on 3 October 2021, four days after the launch.
events.quote: Applications for long-stay residency status will begin to be received electronically on 3 October via the Ministry’s Investment Services Centre.

events.title: EB-5 investor visa takes effect (Immigration Act of 1990, title I)
events.description: Sec. 161(a) of the Immigration Act of 1990 makes the amendments of title I, including sec. 121 creating INA 203(b)(5) 'Employment creation', take effect on 1 October 1991 and apply from fiscal year 1992. Sec. 121 is not among the sections listed in sec. 161(b) as taking effect on enactment (29 Nov 1990).
events.quote:

events.title: First Real Estate Option route repealed (Act No. 40 of 2014)
events.description: Citizenship (Amendment) Act No. 40 of 2014 (assent 19 Dec 2014, in force on publication, 23 Jan 2015) repeals s.13CA.

programs.name: 'Investor' category of the UK Immigration Rules (paras 224-229), 1994-2008
programs.notes: Predecessor of the Tier 1 (Investor) visa (gbr-tier1-investor), with its own legal basis: paragraphs 224 to 229 of the Immigration Rules, deleted by HC 607 from 30 June 2008 when Tier 1 (Investor) (paras 245O-245U) replaced it. The MAC (2014) dates the route to 1 October 1994: applicants had to hold at least GBP 1 million in the UK, invest GBP 750,000 in UK Government bonds, stocks or corporate bonds and make the UK their main home; from 2004 the funds could be borrowed from a UK regulated institution if personal net assets were at least twice the investment. The 1994 text itself is not stored; the launch date is the start date given by the MAC. No separate counts found.

programs.name: Real Estate Option Program, first route (Citizenship Act s.13CA, 2014-2015)
programs.notes: First Real Estate Option route: s.13CA of the Citizenship Act, inserted by Act No. 18 of 2014 (assent 19 Jun 2014, in force on publication in the Gazette, 8 Jul 2014), let an investor holding a residence visa under the Real Estate Option Program of the Immigration Visa Regulation Order No. 180 of 2011 apply for citizenship. Repealed by Act No. 40 of 2014 (in force 23 Jan 2015). A separate Real Estate Option Program was created in 2021 under s.13F (vut-reo). No figures found.
